headline: Seattle Pacific pull clear at the top of the conference
dek: Seattle Pacific have won twelve matches, drawn one and lost two, and have not been beaten since the opening night of conference play at Northwest Nazarene. Their 36 goals in all matches are more than any other programme has scored.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Saint Martin's 32 goals are more than Simon Fraser, Western Washington or Northwest Nazarene have scored, yet they sit bottom of the table: goals in this conference have not bought points.

wire.line: Saint Martin's have won seven matches, none of them in conference play.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Three matches whose dates have passed carry no result, and every one of them is a Simon Fraser home match from August.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Archie Dhima has 13 goals from 48 shots for Western Oregon.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Elijah Brockl has kept six shutouts for Northwest Nazarene.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Of the shots on target Austin Valdez has faced for Western Oregon, 61 were saved and 18 went in.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Northwest Nazarene have won eight matches, drawn five and lost three.

last_match.line: Northwest Nazarene answered their defeat at Simon Fraser earlier in the month.

next_match.line: Western Oregon's only conference defeat came at Seattle Pacific earlier in the month.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
